requirements.evidence: All contract items present: migrations with owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_one_owner (create_entity_memberships_table.php:19-31), models/enum/factories, policies (EntityPolicy.php, EntityMembershipPolicy.php), middleware dispatch 0/1/>1 + 403 (ResolveCurrentEntity.php:28-53), /home via current_entity (routes/web.php:22-24), pick with audit log (EntityController.php:19-28), CreateEntity with retry loop calling uniqueSlug() each attempt (CreateEntity.php:35-57), switcher markup with data-current (switcher.blade.php:9-13), navbar link (default-page.blade.php:14-16), lang keys both locales. Small gaps: a stale session entity makes /home 403 instead of re-dispatching; dashboard for a different member entity than the session one renders without syncing the session.

conventions.evidence: Domain write (entity + owner membership creation) is done inline in the Livewire component (CreateEntity.php:38-50) instead of an app/Actions class (e.g. CreateEntity action authorizing inside), which conventions.md requires for domain writes. Otherwise good: #[Validate] + $this->validate() (CreateEntity.php:21,27), policies for auth, #[Fillable] set, migrations with down(), docs/database-schema.md, architecture.md and CHANGELOG updated, persistent middleware registered (AppServiceProvider.php:41-43). Switcher reads are in a route closure (routes/web.php:30-34) rather than a controller like sibling routes.

security.evidence: submit() validates and authorizes ('create', Entity::class) and forces role Owner server-side (CreateEntity.php:27-29,45-47); Dashboard authorizes view in mount and #[Locked] entity (Dashboard.php:14-21); pick uses policy view before touching session (EntityController.php:19); output escaped with {{ }}; middleware persisted for Livewire updates. Minor: no rate limit on entity creation, and any user can create unlimited entities via /onboarding.

tests.evidence: Three feature files cover model/DB constraints, policy matrices, onboarding (validation, owner, session, slug suffix, insert-time collision retry via overridden uniqueSlug, audit log, soft-deleted slug), middleware dispatch, 403 paths, pick forbidden with session untouched, switcher markup and navbar. Gaps: the pick audit log is not asserted despite the test name ('logs audited', EntityTenantTest.php:118-129); no unauthorized/guest Livewire call or tamper test for CreateEntity::submit as the Livewire policy requires.

simplicity.evidence: Lean overall; policies share small private helpers; slug retry loop is direct. Minor indirection: EntityMembershipPolicy::membershipForEntity merely wraps User::membershipFor (EntityMembershipPolicy.php:41-44); middleware also binds app()->instance('current_entity') in addition to request attributes (ResolveCurrentEntity.php:61-62), which nothing in the diff uses.

readability.evidence: Clear names and PHPDoc; small methods. submit() is fairly long with the retry loop and $lastException bookkeeping (CreateEntity.php:25-71); the old resources/views/home.blade.php appears to be left unused after /home moved to HomeController.

scope.evidence: No members/settings pages, locale middleware or navbar redesign; only the business-rules intro sentence edit (docs/business-rules.md:3) beyond the required docs, which is a docs-freshness update.

issues.explanation: Entity and owner-membership creation is a domain write done directly in the Livewire component instead of a dedicated app/Actions class that authorizes internally, as the project conventions require.
The pick test is named as checking the audit log but never asserts that the 'Entity selected' audit entry is written.
No unauthorized (guest) Livewire call or tamper test for CreateEntity::submit, which the Livewire security policy mandates for every action.

When the session holds an entity the user no longer belongs to (removed or entity deleted), /home returns 403 permanently instead of clearing the session and re-dispatching, leaving the user stuck until logout.
Entity creation has no rate limit and onboarding stays open to users who already have entities, allowing unbounded entity creation.
The switcher query lives in a route closure while sibling entity routes use a controller (EntityController).
app()->instance('current_entity', ...) duplicates the request attribute and is unused in the change.
membershipForEntity is a pointless wrapper around User::membershipFor.

review.summary: The change implements the entity data model with a portable DB-level single-owner constraint, policies, the current_entity middleware, onboarding with insert-time slug-collision retry, switcher, navbar link and dashboard, with docs and a solid feature test suite. It needs changes mainly because the domain write bypasses the project's app/Actions pattern, and a few tests required by the Livewire policy (unauthorized/tamper on submit, pick audit log) are missing.
